denominator: loaded elementary/middle/high dashboard directory entries, not official enrollment population
notes: Minima are the actual app linkage counts observed on the reference CI run, not official district school totals.
An official third-party service outage makes the comparison INCONCLUSIVE for affected districts; it must not become a false source-absence conclusion.
A non-outage drop in loaded school count or matched polygons requires review, and intended district boundary updates must explicitly revise the baseline with fresh evidence.
CFB has no configured school-specific GIS polygon export; resident finder functionality is independent.
